My dearest Dhvani,

Some people make the world feel a little brighter just by being in it. For me, that person is you.

With you, ordinary moments become my favorite memories, and even the quietest days feel full of love. Your smile is my favorite kind of magic, and your happiness means more to me than words can ever say.

This Karwa Chauth, under the beautiful moon, I want to remind you that you are loved — not just today, but in all the little tomorrows waiting for us.

Thank you for being you. If I could make one wish tonight, it would be for a lifetime of laughter, warmth, and love with you. ❤️

Forever yours,
Sumeet ♡
